purpose: First real-data CORR-I pilot input for the SU(3) Yang-Mills 0++ ground state.

source.paper: A. Athenodorou and M. Teper, The glueball spectrum of SU(3) gauge theory in 3+1 dimensions, JHEP 11 (2020) 172.
source.source_kind: digitized published figure; not authors' raw correlator data

digitization.error_bars: not encoded in the chamber input; early-time error bars are partly hidden by marker size and the source figure does not provide tabulated pointwise uncertainties
digitization.horizontal_shifts: figure states that some points are shifted for clarity; the series is interpreted at half-integer interval midpoints 0.5,1.5,...,9.5

reconstruction.reason_no_sigma: Pointwise effective-mass covariance/uncertainties are not tabulated; inventing a diagonal correlator sigma would create unsupported precision.
reconstruction.CORR_I_mode_expected: descriptive compatibility envelope (relative-deviation limits), not diagonal-sigma mode

limitations: This is a normalized correlator proxy reconstructed from a published effective-mass plot.
It is not the original C(t) or C_ij(t) measured by the authors.
Pointwise uncertainty and covariance information are unavailable in the paper tables and are therefore not fabricated.
The large-t rise in the 0++ effective mass is retained because the paper explicitly discusses it as a statistical fluctuation; no smoothing or point removal was performed.
